sourceTitle: Chocolate Sponge Cake With Cream Cheese Frosting
sourceText:
Chocolate Sponge Cake With Cream Cheese Frosting
By: Anncoo
Published: Saturday, May 8, 2010 - 1:47am

Ingredients




Ingredients:
Sponge Cake
2 large Eggs
30 grams Ice water
125 grams Optima flour
1 tablespoon Cocoa powder
1 teaspoon Vanilla extract
40 grams Corn oil
1/2 tablespoon Chocolate paste
Cream Cheese Frosting 
500 grams Cream Cheese, at room temperature
250 grams Butter, at room temperature
2 teaspoons Vanilla extra
1/2 tablespoon Lemon juice
180 grams Icing sugar

Preparation

1 Chocolate Sponge Cake: 2 Put all the ingredients in mixing bowl and whisk at high speed till thick and fluffy, then lower speed and slowly add corn oil into it and mix well. 3 Pour batter into a 8" lined round cake tin, bake at preheated 180C for about 20 mins. 4 Remove chocolate sponge cake from cake tin and leave to cool. 5 Cut cake into 2 slices. 6 Cream Cheese Frosting: 7 Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and beat until well combined. 8 Add more icing sugar to taste, if a more sweet frosting is preferred. 9 Use immediately to frost the cake. 10 After assembling the cake, allow it to rest in the fridge overnight, before serving. 11 Serve immediately after taking it out of the fridge. 12 Enjoy!
